what: Monospaced text like a radio message is typed at 40 characters per second — an extra pause of .28s after periods, exclamation and question marks, .1s after commas, .12s after colons and semicolons, .14s after dashes, .32s after line breaks, and in the two cells ahead not yet lit, a symbol (! every 55ms<>-_\/[]{}=+*^?#%&$@01) flow in the accent color so it looks like a signal being picked up. Lit characters settle from bright light to their own color in .45s ease-out, and after the last character a .5em block cursor blinks in 1.05s steps once typing finishes. Pressing it prints the rest of the text all at once and fx:typed

options.ahead: Number of leading cells the symbols flow through, default 2 — 0 means no symbols
options.on: load (default, immediately on attach) · state (when is-in is added to the element or an ancestor — after the dialog opens) · event (waits for fx:play)
options.caret: If none, does not draw the square cursor
options.fx:play · fx:finish: Start typing · remaining text all at once (same as a press)
options.fx:typed: Event the element emits when typing is done — the consumer turns on the Continue button·goal list here
options.--fx-gt-flash: Text color at the moment of lighting up, default --kf-ink
